scope: Execution-model audit. Existing binaries only; no runtime changes. Diagnostic runs are not controlled performance comparisons.

runs.prompt_contract: 256 tokens generated by test_prefill_memory lighthouse text; metadata prompt_sha256 is unused CLI default, NOT the actual prompt hash

mtp_inventory.scope: Inventory only; MTP execution and draft quality not tested

limitations: router_sync is a host wait for all preceding queue work, not router kernel time; acquire overlaps GPU work
stage mode synchronizes every stage and changes overlap; stage costs cannot be subtracted from asynchronous totals
xfer MB is MiB; counts reflect demand transfers, not external PCIe byte measurement
memory canary has two identical prefill calls, not a steady-state language workload; X4 uses warm teacher forcing and explicit dense XMX
PCIe 3.0 x16 is from earlier machine documentation; link was not re-probed. 15.754 GB/s is encoding-only, not measured usable bandwidth.
6/8/10 GB/s are sensitivity assumptions, not measured bus rates
no GPU timeline or per-kernel event attribution was collected this turn
audit_runner_source:
param([string]$Tag="execution-story",[string]$Messages="perf/qwen4exp/prompts/story.json",[int]$MaxTokens=48,[switch]$Stages,[switch]$Vtune,[switch]$Memory,[switch]$DenseXmx)
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo="E:/RiderProjects/Aila"
. "$repo/perf/PerfCommon.ps1"
$cfg=Get-AilaOneApiStackConfig -RepoRoot $repo -Path "perf/oneapi-stacks.json"
$stack=Get-AilaOneApiStack -Config $cfg -Name "oneapi-2026.1"
Set-AilaProcessEnvironment -Environment (Get-AilaOneApiStackEnvironment -Stack $stack)
Get-ChildItem Env: | Where-Object { $_.Name -match "^(AILA_|ONEDNN_|DNNL_)" } | Remove-Item
$overrides=@{AILA_PROFILE_Q4E_DECODE="1"; AILA_Q4E_EXPERT_HISTOGRAM="1"; AILA_Q4E_CPU_EXPERT_DISPATCH="0"; AILA_Q4E_EXPERT_READER="readfile"}
if($Stages){$overrides.AILA_PROFILE_Q4E_STAGES="1"}
if($DenseXmx){$overrides.AILA_Q4E_PREFILL_XMX="1"}
foreach($key in $overrides.Keys){Set-Item "env:$key" $overrides[$key]}
$exe="$repo/build-refactor/Aila.exe"
$model="C:/QwenModels/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BNB-NF4-v2"
$prefix="$repo/tmp/$Tag"
$arguments=@("-m",$model,"--max-seq","512","--greedy","--thinking-budget","0","--max-tokens",$MaxTokens,"--messages-json",$Messages)
if($Memory){$exe="$repo/build-refactor/AilaQwen4ExpToleranceTests.exe";$arguments=@("--memory-model",$model)}
$meta=[ordered]@{timestamp=(Get-Date -Format o);commit=(& git -C $repo rev-parse HEAD);dirty=@(& git -C $repo status --short);exe_sha256=(Get-FileHash $exe).Hash;model_config_sha256=(Get-FileHash "$model/config.json").Hash;prompt_sha256=(Get-FileHash "$repo/$Messages").Hash;arguments=$arguments;env_overrides=$overrides;stack=(Get-AilaOneApiStackMetadata -Stack $stack);gpu=@(Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name,DriverVersion);diagnostic_only=$true}
$meta | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content "$prefix.meta.json"
$launcher=$exe
if($Vtune){
 $launcher="C:/Program Files (x86)/Intel/oneAPI/vtune/latest/bin64/vtune.exe"
 $arguments=@("-collect","gpu-offload","-result-dir",$prefix+"-vtune","--",$exe)+$arguments
}
$proc=Start-Process -FilePath $launcher -ArgumentList $arguments -WorkingDirectory $repo -WindowStyle Hidden -PassThru -RedirectStandardOutput "$prefix.log" -RedirectStandardError "$prefix.err.log"
$samples=[System.Collections.Generic.List[object]]::new()
$timer=[System.Diagnostics.Stopwatch]::StartNew()
$pressure=$false
while(!$proc.WaitForExit(500) -and $timer.Elapsed.TotalSeconds -lt 240){
 $proc.Refresh();$free=(Get-CimInstance Win32_OperatingSystem).FreePhysicalMemory/1024
 $samples.Add([pscustomobject]@{ms=$timer.ElapsedMilliseconds;working_set_bytes=$proc.WorkingSet64;private_commit_bytes=$proc.PrivateMemorySize64;system_free_mb=$free})
 if($free -lt 8192){$pressure=$true;break}
}
if(!$proc.HasExited){$proc.Kill($true);$proc.WaitForExit();$meta.watchdog_stop=$true;$meta.memory_pressure=$pressure}
$proc.WaitForExit();$meta.exit_code=$proc.ExitCode
$meta.peak_working_set_bytes=($samples | Measure-Object working_set_bytes -Maximum).Maximum
$meta.minimum_system_free_mb=($samples | Measure-Object system_free_mb -Minimum).Minimum
$meta.log_sha256=(Get-FileHash "$prefix.log").Hash
$meta.err_log_sha256=(Get-FileHash "$prefix.err.log").Hash
$meta | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content "$prefix.meta.json"
$samples | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 3 | Set-Content "$prefix.memory.json"
Get-Content "$prefix.log" | Select-Object -Last 12
Get-Content "$prefix.err.log" | Select-Object -Last 5
exit $proc.ExitCode
